qualification: Code-read audit except the single small real-file reader run in measurement.json.

items.title: Studio drop
answer: A 1 MiB GeoJSON drop uses neither sources nor uploads: it goes to import-packages/inspect,
then import-packages after manual confirmation; CA0's automatic retained-source path is API-only.

fact: GIS extensions geojson/json/gpkg/zip are sent whole as FormData to POST /api/v1/import-packages/inspect.
Start import sends one selected GIS original to POST /api/v1/import-packages; no file-size branch.
Other types stay not-gis; CSV/XLSX get an explicit Import as a table button (:252-255).
No generic retained-original intake tray or multipart upload client is connected here.
Only opt-in DEV/hosted-demo plus VITE_DEMO_IMPORT=1 tries /api/demo/inspect and /api/demo/imports.
AddFilesDialog.tsx:139-151 falls back to real import inspection when the demo profile refuses.
This is the hash-qualified NYC development transport, not the canonical streaming-vector reader.

evidence.fact: Only the table dialog uses POST /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/sources, as csv/xlsx.
The generic typed client publishes uploads/stream reads but does not choose an upload strategy.

fact: API GeoJSON retention is geojson-manual-v1, <=16 MiB and <=2000 features; approval queues CA0.
The area-import drop instead creates geojson-area-v2 (areas.ts:681-702), not that manual receipt.
A 1 MiB file cannot use uploads at all: ingestion.ts:189-193 requires >16 MiB for both profiles.

items.title: Large original retention and probe
items.condition: API upload, active unassigned case, local owner, configured v2 capacity and storage.

fact: Both profiles cut transport at 8 MiB. v1 file >16 to128 MiB (<=16 parts); v2 >16 MiB to7 GiB (896).
v1: active case2/operator2/global4, lifetime receipts128, reserved originals512 MiB, copies1 GiB.
v2: active global1, lifetime receipts8, originals7 GiB, copies ceiling22 GiB; opt-in reservation.
Receipt lifetime is 24h/7d, not renewal of the lifetime receipt count; attempts part3/finalization3.
v1 lease180s/finalize120s/cleanup120s, v2 lease180s/finalize12h/cleanup12h; transport requests30s.
File-size/media admission is Zod in create; count and byte reservations are SQL under a global lock.
Receipt counts include retained AND aborted rows globally, not per case or just active files.
The 129th fresh v1 receipt gets 429 UPLOAD_QUOTA; aborting old receipts does not clear that count.
The ninth v2 receipt likewise fails; missing v2 configuration is503 UPLOAD_CAPACITY_UNCONFIGURED.
Reservations sum all non-aborted originals. Configured total requires2*v1Reserved+3*v2Reserved.
v1's 1 GiB copy ceiling is implied by512 MiB originals and two copies, not a separate disk scan.
v2's22 GiB is the fullCeilingConfigured display threshold; actual admission checks configured bytes.
Part number/size is recomputed from the admitted file; only one writing part per receipt at a time.
Server rejects differing received length/hash with422 PART_INTEGRITY; repeated attempts are capped.
POST uploads; PUT uploads/:uploadId/parts/:partNumber; POST finalize. Raw body is<=one exact part.
HTTP raw-reader concurrency4 (:50), content type octet-stream, request/hash/revision headers required.
Size and lifetime checks are independent of semantic reader or package admission.
v1 finalize streams assembled bytes and verifies size/hash; v2 queues large-original-storage then MPU.
Both insert sources at revision1, profile large-original-v1, status needs_input; no semantic records.
Inspection holds uploadId, operator, ETag, verified hash/bytes, caller-declared provenance, unsupported.
Case revision advances once. Cleanup fences temporary objects, never deletes the retained original.
Finalize emits upload.changed; it does not itself parse the file or call probeOriginal.
A500 MiB retained GeoJSON is size class L; probe reads64 KiB head and64 KiB tail (intake.ts:5-7).
Initial feature count, native extent, geographic extent and CRS code are null. No body scan.
Count stays unknown when the whole file is not in the head; geometry types/columns are sampled<=16.
CRS known only if a literal header declaration before features has a recognized code; else absent/null.
Extent is metadata-only bbox, never computed from samples; EPSG4326 extent only for exact EPSG:4326.
No header bbox means unknown, not a sampled500 MiB layer extent; CRS84 literal needs deeper resolution.

items.title: Streaming reader
items.condition: Works on the measured NYC original; a500 MiB or1 GB original is refused before a job is queued.

fact: Local private POST sources/:sourceId/streaming-vector queues202; GET jobs and chunks read history.
PrivateSpatialGuard only blocks cross-site (:9-11); service enforces configured local source ownership.
No named officer role check here: streaming-vector.ts:45-60 uses the local operator subject and access.
A request queues one canonical streaming-vector job per file; dispatcher starts it (processing.ts:227).
Source bytes>128 MiB are413 STREAMING_SOURCE_BUDGET; large-original media type must be octet-stream.
Active queued/running imports>=2 globally are429 STREAMING_CAPACITY.
Operations kind streaming-vector>=128 globally are429 STREAMING_HISTORY_CAPACITY, even finished jobs.
Same request replay returns its job before caps; a new request still counts. These are finite guards,
not renewable quotas; there is no reclamation path in enqueue (:144-146).
Part<=100 features/512 KiB, individual value<=1 MiB, <=10000 positions; <=4096 data parts.
Metadata<=64 KiB/32 fields, nesting64, read deadline10min; malformed framing stops, not guessed.
4096*100 gives at most409600 records, below500000; byte-driven splitting can stop much sooner.
lookaheadSlots8 and stagedBytes64 MiB are declared but have no worker references or enforcement.
One retained object-store stream is opened with size and optional largeOriginal ETag; no whole Buffer.
readStreamingFeatures awaits each feature callback; flush awaits storeChunk then acceptSlot sequentially.
Thus actual look-ahead is one pending part, not eight concurrent parts; no map-consumer watermark.
Structural/numeric failures and PostGIS topology failures quarantine the feature and continue.
Oversized draft unit becomes DRAFT_UNIT_BUDGET; oversized complete JSON or malformed framing is terminal.
No Python in GeoJSON reader: streaming-vector-validation.ts:5-19 invokes PostGIS/GEOS per feature.
The Python bounded normalizer is area.py, a separate import step; workbook Python belongs to tables.
usp_streaming_vector_imports holds counts/publish watermark; usp_streaming_vector_slots holds
part index, first/last global feature positions, counts, object key/hash/bytes, status, attempt/fence.
Byte ranges and raw hash are in payload records, NOT slot columns (streaming-vector-reader.ts:234-238).
Payload: parsed JSON for accepted rows, null for quarantined, plus exact byte locator/hash.
Contiguous SQL watermark publishes ready/quarantined slots in order, in the acceptance transaction.
Crash recovery reopens from byte zero, reconstructs prefix and compares hashes/counts/indices.
It is idempotent prefix replay, not seeking to the last byte offset. Three fenced attempts,180s lease,
30s heartbeat; old attempts cannot accept SQL. Retryable faults queue; exhausted/structural faults
append quarantine marker and unknown_remainder=true. Source integrity failure denies chunk reads.
Events: streaming-vector.changed states; streaming-vector.chunk index/hash/counts.
No geometry in events; acceptUspJobAttempt also publishes canonical job.succeeded outbox.

measurement.slots: All17 published ready; one has99 accepted/1 quarantined; last has62 records.
measurement.qualification: Own entry point, throwaway PostGIS; CAR in-memory S3 control, not large-file throughput.

fact: Consumes pinned published raw streaming slots, and an exact approved recipe from usp_mapping_recipes.
GIS recipe versions: manual-geojson/1, streamed-mapping/1, streamed-prefix-mapping/1.
Tabular is manual-tabular/1 carrying mapping-plan/2; pure V2 executor support is not a new GIS authority.
Without GIS approval route=proposal_only, returns needs_input; prefix needs approval.
chunk-mapping/1:100 records,256 KiB,4096 chunks,12min wait,active1 (chunk-mapping.ts contract:12-13).
128 lifetime mapping imports are429 MAPPING_HISTORY_CAPACITY; active1 is429 MAPPING_CAPACITY.
Produces observations: observed/quarantined/unresolved, literal key/name,
feature index/byte range/hash; geometryRef points to raw payload, no local-frame geometry.
Keys reserved across chunks in usp_chunk_mapping_keys; conflicts in usp_chunk_mapping_conflicts.
Later duplicate is conflicting/unresolved; earlier row not rewritten. Identity completion is false.
One part at a time follows raw publication; raw/mapping failures can stop the job, not skip all bad parts.
Stays in slots: usp_chunk_mapping_slots(status ready/quarantined,published=true) plus JSON object.
Raw: usp_streaming_vector_slots. No import_packages,physical_features or registry write.
chunk-mapping.ts:265 and streaming-vector.ts:154 are job INSERTs, not package INSERTs.
GET mapped jobs/:jobId/chunks/:chunkIndex reads these (:303-360); table screen reads values, not the map.
Canonical streaming-vector/chunk-mapping events refresh table status and mapped payload reads.
No canonical GIS-event to scene subscriber in Studio; raw/mapped endpoints are not map inputs.
Real map reads /api/v1/areas/{areaId}/context and /canonical, plus selected building /canonical.
Committed and draft package features use this area projection, not streaming endpoints.
SceneView forwards setBase/setBuildings (packages/scene/src/react.tsx:69-71); incremental drawing exists,
but that does not connect retained raw slots or make their CRS placement qualified.
Only opt-in NYC demo draws parts: /api/demo/areas/:id/events includes features in chunk events.
It appends displayFeatures to area cache; demo-id branch converts to scene footprints/base.
Acknowledgement waits for engine.waitForDrawn, not two frames. No geometry endpoint is fetched per part.
This is not the feature endpoint a committed real package uses, and not the canonical raw-part job.

items.title: Bounded import, many packages, citations
items.condition: Bounded requests into the same pinned area; area-wide review/display caps still apply.

fact: 16 MiB original at ingestArea entry is PER REQUEST, not cumulative area bytes.
2000 features,100000 vertices including geometric rejections,10000 per feature are bounds
per request; MAX_PARTS256 limits shape components/rings. A bad over-budget geometry can fail the request.
50 km width/height is per request; every bound must be within50 km of retained area origin.
20 MiB normalized bound actually counts len(json.dumps(source,...)), serialized source input,
not returned normalized features or UTF8 output bytes. areas.ts:475-492 does not pass maxResultBytes.
Separate effective-set caps apply at review/commit/display; these are not the same per-request bounds.
One area can hold many packages. Existing areaId/reference and expected revision permit a new layer.
No one-package-per-area/original rule; signature includes mapping,source hash,destination.
Same signature retries return same package. New part needs a distinct signature/locator.
source_feature_links(namespace,key) preserve identity; duplicate/correction is not a new building.
NYC buildings1661 plus hydrography1 were legal: count1662<=2000, same frame and fresh pins
(docs/evidence/gf1/ca5/result.json:122-137; ca6/result.json:34-35); not unbounded capacity.
Normalizer enumerates request from0 before quarantine; part7 today gives PART-local index.
Reader's zero-based chunk7 has global positions700..799 at100 features/part, but byte splits vary that.
Use payload.featureIndex per row, not7*100 or firstIndex+acceptedOffset after rejects.
retainedOriginal requires original SHA=hash(input.bytes); part buffer with full-file source id
is rejected as a409 conflict. A governed internal part input is needed, not bypassing this comparison.
Citation uses sourceFeatureIndex to decode ENTIRE original and walk to exact properties text.
Plan reads whole original and hash; sources total>64 MiB is413 PACKET_PLAN_SOURCE_LIMIT.
Need exact per-feature [byteStart,byteEnd) and rawSha256 from raw payload, tied to source hash/index/key.
A part-wide byte range alone includes commas/other features and is insufficient without feature offsets.
Range-read exact feature; return original properties substring, not reserialized properties.
Keep original completion/hash proof and range integrity; global index remains durable identity.

items.title: Cost and hard caps as packages accumulate

fact: reviewPackage loads ALL recorded area features, replaces own IDs, then reads neighbours.
withNeighbours caps features+neighbours at2000 before CA5 splits candidates from context.
Unqualified context counted/omitted from check, but still loaded, associated and fully hashed.
Qualification lookup itself has10000-record scope cap; not safe to lift justAREA_LIMIT to500000.
Cost grows with package PLUS all area geometry/neighbours. Full vertices are walked,
arrays use Math.min(...xs)/max(...xs), full sort; raising count risks argument/memory limits.
Python check stays<=2000 features/100000 vertices/20000 pairs (area.py:441-501).
commitPackage re-reads ALL recorded area features, neighbours and associations for fingerprint.
Then locks/writes only own features, geometry/history/external identifiers: O(package).
CA1 recordCommittedExteriorsTx reads eligible package IDs via p.id=ANY, locks reservations,
writes registry/history per eligible exterior and raises site once; O(package), not O(all area records).
Area/site/advisory locks constant per package; reviewAreaRevision makes later commits stale.
CA2 target closure, linked features,cited sources,aliases,qualifications are scoped to selected targets.
<=100 target pins, closure/features1000, sources2000; these bounds stay per capture, not per area.
Growing read: featureDocumentIds scans import_packages JSON feature arrays for matching IDs globally.
snapshotPackageParts reads ALL packages for selected source cases; retained area packages use separate
archived cases, so that scan need not grow for this retained-source chain.
featureDocumentIds scan still grows with package history despite target-scoped output.
CA2 is not completely constant-time; index/relational observation-package membership needed.

projection.nyc: 1661 accepted: review2466.347ms including readback; commit7724.103ms; CA0 older combined46.6s.
projection.actual: 250 disjoint packages of2000 cannot run today: review of second exceeds2000 and refuses AREA_LIMIT.
linearThoughtExperiment: If only package-sized work remained,500000/1661 times the NYC10.19045s gives~3067.6s (~51.1min).
This is extrapolation, not a benchmark or promise; shape/pairs/IO/packet/card costs are not predicted by it.
areaWideWork: 250*251/2*2000=62750000 effective feature visits per full-area pass, vs500000 package feature writes.
Review and commit repeat scans; growing term quadratic in package count at fixed part size.
No measured split of the10.2s into fixed/package/area terms, so a numerical quadratic wall time is unknown.
CA2's unindexed package JSON search adds growth even when each target snapshot contains one feature.

items.title: Large-original source authority
items.warning: The question's assumption that every listed authority refuses large-original-v1 is not true.

fact: isRetainedMapOriginal admits only exact geojson-manual-v1/manual receipt+GIS hash, not large-original-v1.
bindRetainedCaseTx has NO profile restriction: unassigned active case with UNASSIGNED frame works.
Archived/wrong-site/own-frame case:403 AREA_SOURCE_DENIED; site-only update never changes revision.
Package authority does NOT refuse profile: quarantine pin/site/local-owner must agree.
Before case binding that check is403 AREA_SOURCE_DENIED (:27-30); after correct binding it can pass.
Unmarked large originals are not staged documents; documentAuthorityTx returnsfalse, not a denial.
Snapshot does NOT reject profile; same-site source selected by citation is captured.
Without binding it is absent from sources (snapshots.ts:191-195), not a profile refusal.
Exact original/access checks remain; capture alone grants no excerpt or registry eligibility.
A500 MiB source fails413 PACKET_PLAN_SOURCE_LIMIT at64 MiB before extract eligibility is considered.
A bound large-original smaller than64 MiB fails featureSupported, leaving exact_extract_unavailable and
blocked_required_context; confirm/execute:422 PACKET_PLAN_BLOCKED (packets/plan-service.ts:142-143).
Without active same-site case, declaration evidence guard gives403 DECLARATION_SOURCE_DENIED instead.
permitsFeatureRecordSource returnsfalse for large-original-v1; status needs_input has no parsed features.
Registry evidence validation fails422 EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE. CA1's exterior lift does not call it,
so no hidden profile refusal at CA1 commit (exterior-records.ts:12-38).
Smallest change: exact record-only large map admission; never turn all opaque originals ready.

items.title: One layout across a large file
items.condition: Streamed profile/recipe within reader bounds; automatic proposal/package execution absent.

fact: Manual inspect/author/decide needs profile built by parsing whole<=16 MiB/2000 original.
large-original-v1 is422 UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE; no manual receipt manufactured for large files.
streamed-profile job consumes raw published parts;64 paths,4097 generations,100 quarantine locators,
64 KiB generation body,active1,12min wait;128 lifetime imports =>429 STREAMED_PROFILE_HISTORY.
Cumulative generation per part plus sealed generation at verified EOF; no original reread.
Large reference stays null: streamed-profile-worker.ts:67-76,93-99 takes CRS only from manual GIS.
Raw metadata result not persisted as CRS evidence; streamed mapping is not placement.
One approved streamed-mapping/1 pins sealed profile,source,raw job and hash; reused across all raw parts.
streamed-prefix-mapping/1 pins immutable observed prefix and permits later compatible
features; drift is unresolved, not remapped (chunk-mapping-normalizer.ts:47-72,146-153).
Approval hash covers exact SOURCE, allows its parts with no new per-part approval.
Cannot transfer to another file; author/approve hashes and meaning evidence are exact-source pins.
Key/name must complete literal strings; officer cites issuing portal meaning and provenance (:70-79).
Streamed plan has no destination or execute-package. proposal-only returns review required
(chunk-mapping-worker.ts:185-196), not automatic large-file proposal.
